Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, ...);` with `require(false, ...);` so the onlyAdmin modifier always reverts, making setOwner always fail and never change owner.
Remove the `onlyAdmin` modifier from setOwner, allowing anyone to change owner.
Change the owner assignment to `owner = _owner; owner = address(0);` so owner is always reset to zero after assignment.
Change the return value from true to false.
Replace `owner = _owner` with `owner = address(0)` so the owner is not set to the argument.
Remove the `onlyAdmin` modifier so anyone can change the owner.

Replace `msg.sender == admin` with `true` so the onlyAdmin check always passes.
